d: Plat4mation Saudi Arabia is seeking a Marketing Specialist to support marketing, communications, brand awareness, and business growth activities in the Saudi market. In this role, you will work closely with local and global teams to support marketing campaigns, events, digital content, internal and external communications, and other initiatives that strengthen Plat4mation’s presence in the market.
This is an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in building a career in B2B marketing, digital marketing, communications, technology marketing, and event management.
q: Diploma in Business Administration with a Marketing specialization.
Interest in marketing, technology, digital transformation, and B2B communications.
Basic understanding of digital marketing, social media, content creation, or event coordination.
Ability to create clear and engaging written content.
Ability to collaborate effectively with different teams and stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple activities.
Exposure to technology, B2B marketing, digital marketing, events, or communications is advantageous.
Good English and Arabic communication skills are advantageous.
